graph_data.title: Retail Campaign Assistant with Human-Approved Ad Changes
assumptions: The ad platform exposes an external API for reading campaign metrics and applying targeting and ad-copy changes.
A human marketing operator approves or denies each exact proposal before any change is applied.
Approvals carry an expiry; an approval older than its validity window is treated as stale and the change is not applied.
Writes to the ad platform can time out after commit, so every change is reconciled by authoritative read-back using a stable operation identity.
Rollback reuses the same proposal, validation, approval, execution, and audit controls as normal changes.
The assistant does not retrain models or update prompts from feedback; proposals are generated from stored metrics and rules.

nodes.label: Marketing reviewer console
nodes.description: Lets marketing operators review each exact proposed ad-copy or targeting change, then approve or deny it; denial records the decision and stops execution.

nodes.label: Metrics ingestion service
nodes.description: Reads campaign performance metrics from the ad platform API and stores normalized snapshots with source and collection-time provenance.

nodes.label: Campaign metrics store
nodes.description: Durably stores timestamped campaign metric snapshots used as the factual basis for proposals; scoped by campaign and version.

nodes.label: Proposal generation service
nodes.description: Analyzes stored campaign metrics and produces typed, exact-action proposals for ad-copy edits and audience-targeting changes, citing the metrics used.

nodes.label: Proposal validation service
nodes.description: Deterministically validates every proposal's structure, allowed actions, budget and targeting constraints, and referenced metric freshness before it can be approved or executed.

nodes.label: Approval and policy service
nodes.description: Records approval or denial of each exact validated proposal, enforces approval expiry so stale approvals cannot execute, and authorizes execution or rollback of that specific proposal.

nodes.label: Approval and lifecycle store
nodes.description: Authoritative owner of proposal and approval lifecycle state (proposed, approved, denied, expired, applied, rolled back) with the stable operation identity reserved before any write.

nodes.label: Ad platform execution service
nodes.description: Applies only currently approved exact changes to the ad platform under a durable operation identity; revalidates authorization and approval freshness before executing; handles both normal changes and rollbacks.

nodes.label: Write reconciliation service
nodes.description: Recovers uncertain write outcomes by authoritative read-back of the operation identity: COMMITTED records success, NOT_FOUND permits same-key retry, STILL_UNKNOWN triggers bounded escalation and compensation.

nodes.label: Audit and provenance log
nodes.description: Append-only correlated record of metric inputs, proposals, validation results, approvals and denials, stale-approval rejections, executions, uncertain outcomes, reconciliations, and rollbacks.

nodes.label: Ad platform
nodes.description: External advertising platform that serves campaign metrics and is the authoritative target where approved ad-copy and audience-targeting changes are applied and read back.

engineering_annotation.detail: The initial execution path reaches n8 through n6's authorization verdict, but no contract supplies n8 the exact approved action payload and stable operation identity from canonical proposal or lifecycle ownership before the write.
engineering_annotation.secondary_detail: n9 declares STILL_UNKNOWN compensation, but no n9 path reaches the proposal producer or operator with the original operation reference. The separate manual n1 rollback path does not establish this declared recovery initiation.
